decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template sits close to the firm's agency and shop hosting know-how, so its in-house R&D team can read early results and keep improving it.
The responsive website template builds directly on the firm's CMS hosting expertise and is cheap to maintain, which makes it easy to assimilate and refine.
Premium support extends the firm's core round-the-clock expert support and fits its agency-focused strategy, so the firm can readily learn from customer feedback.
The version management tool builds on the firm's own software and tooling development, has a dedicated page, and reduces recurring work for customers, all of which favour keeping it.
The legal contract-creation tool lies far from the firm's technical knowledge base, so the firm can hardly interpret or improve it, and its GDPR-driven relevance fades after the 2018 launch wave.
